title: Students taking all three Math courses
statementMd:
List students enrolled (any semester) in at least three different Math courses.

Expected columns: `name`, `math_courses`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT s.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS math_courses FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.id JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id WHERE c.department = 'Math' GROUP BY s.id, s.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) >= 3;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
